papers.title: Improved Downward-Closed Delegation Bounds
papers.abstract: We study delegated choice under a downward-closed feasibility constraint, where the principal and agent values of each item may be arbitrarily correlated but items are independent. We give a deterministic, agent-oblivious menu that guarantees the principal more than $29/70\approx0.41429$ of the expected offline optimum under every best response, including ties resolved against the principal. The menu depends only on the feasible family and the principal's value distributions, and verifies a proposal using only its items and their principal values. The previous best guarantee for downward-closed constraints was $0.1098$. Matroid constraints admit a guarantee of one half, which is tight already in rank one, but downward-closed constraints do not: a five-item knapsack instance bounds every deterministic menu by $500/1011$ of the optimum, and no rule with randomized acceptance, even one that knows the agent's utilities, can guarantee more than $30/61$. An explicit computer-assisted family of instances lowers the bound to $0.48105$ for all such rules. The guarantee is proved by contradiction. If every menu in a fixed family earns at most a $29/70$ fraction of the optimum, then a normalized instance satisfies a finite system of affine inequalities among the survival functions, stop-loss transforms and overshoot means of its clipped optima. An exact rational certificate shows that the system is infeasible. We also give a short analytic proof that a single threshold on the reported total value guarantees $3/10$.

papers.title: Query-Sample Tradeoffs for Revenue Maximization
papers.titleZh: 收入最大化中的查询-样本权衡
papers.abstract: We introduce and study the full query-sample tradeoff for revenue maximization with a single buyer whose value follows an unknown distribution. A learner may adaptively combine value samples, which reveal full buyer values, with pricing queries, which reveal only whether a fresh buyer accepts a selected price. The goal is to learn a price that achieves a $(1-\varepsilon)$-multiplicative approximation to optimal revenue with high probability. We ask when, and by how much, reducing the sample budget increases the number of pricing queries required. We establish tight tradeoff bounds for monotone-hazard-rate (MHR), regular, and quasi-monotone-hazard-rate (quasi-MHR) distributions, and almost tight bounds for quasi-regular distributions. Our results reveal sharply different benefits from combining the two information sources. Quasi-MHR distributions admit a smooth intermediate tradeoff: additional samples can reduce the query requirement by polynomial factors. For MHR and regular distributions, however, a sufficiently small constant fraction of the sample-only requirement still leaves the learner facing the full asymptotic query cost attainable with one sample. Our upper bounds are achieved by algorithms that collect all value samples before making queries, while our lower bounds hold even under arbitrary adaptive interleaving of the two forms of access. Along the way, we also fully characterize the sample-only and single-sample query complexities for all four families, eliminating the extra logarithmic dependence on $1/\varepsilon$ in the literature.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么仅靠价格实验或样本数据不足以高效学习最优定价？该问题源于卖家在未知买家估值分布下进行收益最大化时面临的信息获取成本困境。现有研究分别分析了样本复杂度与查询复杂度，但二者结合时的协同效应尚不明确。本文旨在刻画在不同分布假设下，减少样本预算会如何影响所需的价格查询次数。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一个卖方通过两种方式获取信息：一是直接观察买家估值的样本（value sample），二是试探性报价并观察是否成交（pricing query）。目标是以高概率找到接近最优期望收益的价格。学习者可自适应地交替使用两类访问，研究在满足PAC学习标准下，样本数S与查询数Q之间的权衡关系，并针对MHR、正则、拟MHR和拟正则四类分布展开分析。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文建立了四类分布下的紧确查询-样本权衡边界。发现拟MHR分布存在平滑过渡：增加样本可多项式级降低查询需求；而MHR与正则分布则呈现阈值效应——即使样本量仅为样本独占模式的常数倍，仍需承受完整的渐近查询代价。此外，首次消除了以往结果中多余的log(1/ε)因子，实现了端点复杂度的精确刻画。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构造性算法与信息论下界相结合的方法完成分析。上界采用‘先采样后查询’策略，利用单个样本估计收益尺度，再结合结构化搜索（如噪声二分查找、中位数消除）缩小候选价格空间。下界基于KL散度论证，设计难区分的硬实例分布族，并通过加权信息累积证明查询效率受限于样本提供的全局信息增益。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果高度依赖于分布类别假设，且下界证明中非均匀权重的设计虽巧妙但可能缺乏普适性。机制本身对实际部署有一定指导意义，但算法细节较复杂。最值得阅读的是其对信息源互补性的精细刻画、tight bound的证明技巧以及对相关文献中log因子冗余的澄清，适合关注学习与机制交互的研究者精读。

papers.title: Contests versus Contracts in Innovation Procurement
papers.titleZh: 创新采购中的竞赛与合同
papers.abstract: How much competition should a designer introduce when procuring innovation? We study a designer funding multiple technological approaches whose feasibility is learned through experimentation. Between independent contracts and contests, we introduce interdependent contracts, which combine approach-specific rewards with continuation decisions that depend on rivals' outcomes. When both breakthroughs and breakdowns are contractable, these contracts implement the optimum by extracting firms' rents and coordinating experimentation across approaches. When only breakthroughs are contractable, we compare simple mechanisms with constant contractual payments. Under technological symmetry, optimal interdependent contracts terminate experimentation at a success cutoff or deadline. Fixed-prize contests can implement the same innovation outcomes, but their relative expenditure depends on the experimentation horizon: for interior success cutoffs, contests are more expensive when the horizon is short and less expensive when it is sufficiently long. Rank-contingent contests can weakly outperform constant-payment interdependent contracts, but technological heterogeneity can reverse this ranking because individualized contracts better tailor incentives to different approaches. We further characterize optimal interdependent contracts with time-varying payments, extending the comparison beyond simple mechanisms. Our results show how outcome contractability, technological heterogeneity, and payment flexibility shape the desirable form of competition in innovation procurement.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 创新采购常需同时资助多种技术路径，但如何平衡激励成本与创新价值尚不明确。现有研究多聚焦独立合同或完全竞争性竞赛，却忽视了中间形态——即延续决策依对手进展而定，但奖励仍个体化的安排。本文追问：在采购中应引入何种程度的竞争？其核心在于协调探索进程与提供激励之间的权衡。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型设一个采购方资助多家企业研发不同技术，各技术可行性未知，通过实验可能取得突破或发现不可行。企业仅观察自身进展，采购方可观测全局并决定信息披露与合同终止。比较三类机制：独立合同、依对手结果调整终止的互依合同、及奖励共享或依排名分配的竞赛，目标是最优化创新收益减去支付总额。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 当突破与失败均可签约时，互依合同可实现最优：通过失败补偿消除信息租金，并依对手成果协调终止时机。若仅突破可签约，则固定奖金竞赛在短期更贵、长期更省；而依成功次序设奖的竞赛可弱优于互依合同。技术异质性会逆转此结论，因个性化合同更能适配不同激励需求。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用动态机制设计框架，结合指数型单臂老虎机学习过程建模技术不确定性。关键技巧是将努力激励与组合选择分离：利用后验信念动态刻画参与方预期，并通过构建等价支出的奖励池比较不同机制。最优停止规则由边际创新价值与时间递增的实施成本阈值比较得出。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设采购方可承诺信息披露与终止规则，且企业风险中性，这在现实中可能受限。机制虽具启发性，但实施需精细设计。最值得读的是其对‘竞争维度’的拆解——将延续依赖与支付依赖分开分析，提供了比传统‘合同vs竞赛’二分法更细粒度的设计视角。

papers.title: Envy-Free Cake-Cutting for Five Agents
papers.abstract: We study the envy-free cake-cutting problem, in which a divisible resource must be divided among a set of agents with heterogeneous preferences in a way that ensures that no agent envies the piece obtained by another. Remarkably, under some mild continuity assumptions on the agent valuations, it is known that an envy-free division where each agent receives a \emph{connected} piece of the cake is always guaranteed to exist. When the valuations are monotone, prior work has shown that a connected $\varepsilon$-envy-free division can be obtained using $\poly(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ queries for up to four agents, leaving the case of five or more agents open. In this work, we develop a new simpler approach that yields such an efficient algorithm for five agents. Our algorithm uses $\mathcal{O}(\log^3(1/\varepsilon))$ queries and also yields a novel proof of existence for five agents that does not rely on any fixed-point theorems beyond the intermediate value theorem.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么无法用已知方法高效实现五人无妒忌蛋糕分割？此前研究虽证明了连通份额下无妒忌分配的存在性，但仅对至多四人提供了多项式对数查询复杂度的近似算法。五人情形长期开放，因传统基于固定点或偏好不变性的构造失效。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，解决单调估值下高效近似协议的设计难题。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑五个代理人对区间[0,1]上的蛋糕进行分割，每人获得一个连通子区间。代理人具有单调、Lipschitz连续的估值函数，通过价值查询获取信息。目标是设计一个机制，在允许少量加性妒忌（ε-envy-free）的前提下，用尽可能少的查询找到分配方案，且不依赖割刀查询或密度假设。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明了对于五名代理人，存在一种确定性算法，可在O(log⁵(1/ε))次价值查询内计算出ε-无妒忌分配。这首次实现了五人情形下的poly(log(1/ε))查询复杂度，并给出了不依赖不动点定理的新颖存在性证明，仅基于中间值定理，增强了构造性和算法可实现性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者引入‘锚点切分’m与四段保留区间P₁,P₂,P₃,P₄的结构，定义‘稳健性’——任一代理人离开后，剩余四人仍可无妒忌分配。通过连续移动m并维护稳健划分，结合中间值定理论证存在某m*使新增的右段R成为某代理人的最爱，从而完成分配。算法采用嵌套二分搜索实现。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果局限于五人情形，未推广到六人及以上；算法虽多项式对数查询，但指数级于ε，实际效率受限。然而其新架构绕开了传统固定点依赖，为后续研究提供新路径。最值得阅读的是其简洁的存在性论证与可转化为算法的构造性思路。

papers.title: The Oracle Is Not Enough: Secure Settlement for Prediction Markets
papers.titleZh: 预言机还不够：预测市场的安全结算
papers.abstract: Prediction markets are becoming an important mechanism for aggregating information and forecasting uncertain real-world events. As they grow in scale and value, reliable settlement becomes critical because settlement determines the winning outcome and allocation of market collateral. Yet many heterogeneous markets require market-specific evidence and interpretation, and incorrect settlement can create direct financial incentives for manipulation. In this paper, we ask how to settle heterogeneous markets correctly and efficiently at scale. We first compare existing settlement designs in their support for heterogeneous markets, reliance on direct operator intervention, and resistance to manipulation, motivating a layered architecture that combines incentivized crowdsourcing with stake-backed voting and selective post-settlement review. Building on this architecture, we develop a stake-backed settlement protocol that provides economic security and settlement liveness under market-specific verification costs. Specifically, we prove that manipulation is unprofitable for every settled market and give two constructions that support sufficient self-enforcing participation with controlled reward expenditure. Using historical Polymarket and UMA data, we evaluate the protocol under real-world conditions. We find that 99% of admitted markets can be settled with modest participation rewards even under high verification costs.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 预测市场通过聚合分散信息来预测现实事件，但其结算过程面临异质性、操纵风险和效率三重挑战。现有方案要么依赖中心化操作员干预，要么无法抵御投票操纵。本文关注如何在无需持续人工介入的前提下，确保大量异构市场的结算既正确又抗攻击。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型包含提议者、理性投票者和第二层审查方。每个市场有明确的正确结果，投票者需付出异质性验证成本才能获知真相。协议采用质押投票机制，结合挑战-投票-申诉流程，并通过奖励规则激励参与。关键设定是质押可重复使用（restaking），且操纵收益与验证成本均市场特定。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出一种分层结算架构，证明只要满足‘准入证书’——即总质押足够覆盖操纵收益且个体累积负载不超限——则任何合谋操纵都无法获利。同时设计两种奖励机制，在控制支出前提下保障足够的诚实参与，使绝大多数市场可用小额奖励安全结算。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构建‘攻击配置’与‘收费机制’证明经济安全性，利用比例负载分配处理质押复用问题。对于参与激励，提出贪心扫描与保护层构造两种方法，前者用于单市场均衡求解，后者通过保守预算解决多市场耦合难题，确保承诺组合仍满足安全条件。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设第二层审查总能纠正错误，现实中可能受限于其可信度；且结果依赖于精确的成本估计。尽管如此，该文对去中心化预言机的设计极具指导意义，尤其在机制抽象、激励兼容性分析和分层问责结构方面提供了可复用的理论框架。

papers.title: Speculative Decoding for Semantic-ID-Based Generative Recommendations
papers.abstract: Generative recommender systems with Semantic IDs (SIDs) represent each item as a short sequence of $L$ discrete tokens and use a sequence model to predict the next item's tokens from a user's history. Industry-scale deployments typically use these models to retrieve multiple candidates per request with constrained beam search. However, this incurs a fixed cost of $L$ sequential model calls per request, and accuracy degrades as the SID generator becomes less sharp, without a guarantee on how close the output is to the exact top-$K$. Production systems therefore cannot detect degraded retrieval for individual requests. We propose SIDECAR, which uses approximate draft candidates and a tree-attention pass to score the entire draft in a single model call, memory permitting. This pass bounds the probability of every unexplored SID prefix and certifies the exact top-$K$ if the draft contains them. Otherwise, a branch-and-bound fallback expands only the parts of the trie that can still change the output, reaching certification within at most $L$ calls for any draft. Moreover, under a budget of $M$ tokens per call and $Y$ calls, which for $Y = L$ matches the resources of a beam search of width $M$, SIDECAR announces a factor $1 + δ$ within which its list will be exact at every rank. Depending on model sharpness, SIDECAR returns the exact top-$K$ using a fraction of beam search's calls or memory. Even when the budget is too small to recover the exact top-$K$, SIDECAR, unlike beam search, reports the announced factor, allowing the serving system to stop early once a quality target or latency limit is reached.

papers.title: OmniEVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embedding for Multi-modal Retrieval
papers.titleZh: OmniEVIE: 面向多模态检索的证据向量感知嵌入
papers.abstract: Multimodal retrieval must match dense pages, fine-grained entities, ordered video, and agent tools and memory. Single-vector embeddings lose local evidence, cross-encoders reread every recalled item online, and uncompressed late interaction is too large to serve. We present OmniEVIE, a 4.5B multi-vector embedding model covering text, images, visual documents, video, and tools with one compressed index and a three-stage retriever. Each record stores at most 128 int8 vectors of dimension 64 (9,472 bytes, or 8.82 GiB per million records), providing a mean vector, 1-bit signs, and int8 multi-vectors for coarse, middle, and final search while localizing each hit to a page region or video interval. Training, merging, indexing, and retrieval are co-designed: all tasks share one retrieval format, a three-grade evidence check removes false negatives, dynamic sampling follows the baseline-teacher gap, candidates are compressed with ST-HAC during training to match the index, stage-wise and specialist models are merged by parameter block, and a saliency gate with a noise floor refines query scoring. Trained on public datasets, OmniEVIE scores 60.68 (full d=2048 sequence) and 60.06 (K128 x d64 int8 index) on MMEB-V3 (190 tasks), 77.96 on MMEB-V2 (78 tasks), and 62.96 on ViDoRe V3 (48 tasks). On 1M and 5M records, a single-thread query takes 54.2 ms and 120.2 ms (11.1x and 25.3x faster than exact 4096-d single-vector search; 236x and 532x faster than full int8 MaxSim). Video is encoded directly from frames without a parsing model: on QVHighlights (1,083 queries), the peak falls inside the labeled segment for 78.0% of queries and the returned span (18% of video length) intersects it for 94.3% vs. 44.9% random. Weights and code: https://huggingface.co/tencent/OmniEVIE-4B and https://github.com/Tencent/OmniEVIE.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 传统单向量检索难以应对多模态场景中依赖局部证据的匹配需求，如视频动作顺序或文档细粒度区域。现有晚期交互虽能保留细节，但高维向量索引开销巨大，无法实用。本文聚焦于如何在压缩存储的同时保留决定性局部证据，解决多模态检索中精度与效率的根本矛盾。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型接收文本、图像、视频或工具文档作为候选，与多模态查询进行匹配。训练基于57个公开数据集，统一建模为检索样本，并引入三等级证据标注机制筛选负例。推理采用三级压缩索引，在千万级语料中定位相关页面区域或视频时间段，评估涵盖跨模态分类、问答、定位等综合任务。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出OmniEVIE，一个45亿参数的多向量嵌入模型，通过单一压缩索引支持文本、图像、视觉文档、视频和工具检索。在百万级语料上单线程查询仅需54毫秒，比全量搜索快236倍，同时在MMEB-V3等综合基准上达到60.06分，接近未压缩上限，显著优于同类系统。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心是ST-HAC聚类与三阶段检索协同设计：训练时对token向量进行时空感知的层次聚类，保留孤立关键证据；索引存储均值、符号位和int8中心点；检索时依次用均值粗筛、汉明距离中选、int8向量精排，既保持证据可定位性又大幅降低计算量。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型优势集中在需局部匹配的任务，对全局语义判别提升有限，且压缩过程仍增加约20ms处理延迟。最值得阅读的是其系统级设计思想——从训练、压缩到检索全流程协同优化，为实用化多模态检索提供了可扩展范本，尤其适合长文档与视频场景。

papers.title: See the Answer, Learn to Embed: Learning Universal Multimodal Embeddings from Hindsight
papers.abstract: Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) models map heterogeneous multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space, where pairwise similarity supports diverse downstream tasks. Recent reasoning-driven UME approaches use intermediate reasoning to generate additional context for embedding, but often incur extra computation at inference. In this paper, we explore the matched candidate (i.e., the paired target) as an alternative source of context, asking whether a model can "see the answer" during training and "learn to embed" without it at inference. However, direct conditioning on this privileged context can introduce candidate-specific information unavailable from the query alone or cause the candidate-conditioned query representation to collapse toward the candidate embedding. To address this, we introduce Hindsight-Enhanced Multimodal Embeddings (HEME), which learns query-grounded hindsight representations from such candidate context. HEME first trains a hindsight teacher with a hindsight attention mask, mismatched-candidate conditioning, and query-token alignment to limit excessive reliance on the candidate. It then freezes the teacher and distills its hindsight representation and similarity distribution into a standalone student embedder. At inference, the student independently encodes queries and candidates without candidate conditioning or the hindsight teacher. Experiments on MMEB-V2 and the agent and text tasks of MMEB-V3 demonstrate the effectiveness of HEME and show that it enables more efficient inference than explicit reasoning-driven methods.

papers.title: LARF: Learning-aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance
papers.titleZh: LARF：面向搜索相关性的学习对齐推理框架
papers.abstract: Query-document relevance estimation is a core component of AI-native search systems, where a model must assess whether retrieved documents satisfy users' information needs under complex, multi-dimensional criteria. However, directly applying large language models (LLMs) to this task remains challenging because conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provides limited supervision for domain-specific judgment rationales, while standard trajectory-level reinforcement learning (RL) objectives do not explicitly enforce margin separation among adjacent ordinal relevance labels. Moreover, although such reasoning can be useful during training, chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is impractical for latency-sensitive online ranking. These challenges make it difficult to resolve ambiguous decision boundaries. We propose a three-stage framework LARF (Learning-Aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance): it first performs cold-start SFT on strategically selected samples with multi-agent guided CoT rationales, then applies discriminative GRPO with attribute-wise, list-wise, and rule-consistency rewards together with a margin loss on the terminal relevance token, and finally distills the teacher into a dual-head student whose classification heads are retained for non-autoregressive inference. On a human-annotated web search relevance benchmark with approximately 300K training and 16K test instances, LARF-8B improves six-class classification accuracy by 5.78 percentage points and NDCG by 5.05 points, while the classification-only serving path reduces inference latency by 82.9\%. These results indicate that aligning structured reasoning, terminal decision optimization, and classification-head distillation can provide an effective accuracy--efficiency trade-off for industrial search relevance modeling.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有大语言模型在搜索相关性判断中难以兼顾细粒度决策与线上效率。传统监督微调缺乏对判断依据的结构化监督，而强化学习仅优化整个推理路径，无法显式区分相邻相关性等级。同时，链式思维推理延迟高，不适合实时排序。这导致模型在模糊边界上决策不稳定，亟需一种既能学习深层判断逻辑又能高效服务的统一框架。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究的是基于多维序数分类的查询-文档相关性建模任务。输入为查询、文档及其元数据，输出为六级相关性评分及四个维度的判断理由。训练使用约30万人工标注样本，结合多智能体生成的链式思维理由进行三阶段学习；推理时仅保留分类头进行非自回归预测。评估采用准确率、NDCG及线上A/B测试满意度指标。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出LARF框架，通过冷启动微调、判别式强化学习与双头蒸馏三阶段设计，在保持高精度的同时大幅降低延迟。在六类分类准确率上提升5.78个百分点，NDCG提高5.05点，且推理延迟下降82.9%。线上测试显著提升用户满意度，证明其在工业级搜索系统中实现了有效的精度-效率权衡。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心在于分离训练与推理路径：先利用多智能体链式思维提供结构化监督，再通过属性级、列表级和规则一致性奖励联合优化，并引入终端标记的间隔损失直接拉大类别间距；最后将推理能力蒸馏至仅含多维分类头的学生模型。这种设计使模型学会复杂判断逻辑却不依赖自回归生成。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 实验集中在特定搜索产品，跨域泛化性待验证；消融虽充分但未测试更小模型容量下的性能极限；高成本的多智能体数据构建可能限制复现。最值得阅读的是其系统级设计思路——如何将复杂的推理学习转化为高效的分类服务，这对工业级LLM应用具有强借鉴意义。

papers.title: MELODI: Similarity-Identity Decoupling for Lightweight Ranking
papers.titleZh: MELODI：用于轻量级排序的相似性-身份解耦
papers.abstract: For latency-constrained candidate ranking, we propose a similarity-identity decoupling framework that separates target-history compatibility from target-only information. We study two orders for computing pooled similarity, similarity-then-pool and pool-then-similarity, and identify linearity of the similarity operator in its history argument, for each fixed target, as sufficient for their equivalence, justifying the cheaper pool-then-similarity form. We instantiate the framework as multi-head efficient lightweight operator for decoupling identity and similarity (MELODI), whose similarity branch combines target-conditioned multi-head history pooling with a single residual-free cross layer that is linear in its pooled-history input and whose identity branch is problem-dependent. On public benchmark datasets, MELODI matches or surpasses the evaluated target-aware and target-agnostic baselines. On two large-scale industrial datasets, its area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC), normalised discounted cumulative gain (NDCG), and recall values are equal to or higher than those of the evaluated target-aware baselines. Processor measurements show lower latency than the evaluated candidate-conditioned baselines at large candidate counts, further reduced by request-local history reuse.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在延迟受限的候选排序任务中，传统方法难以兼顾个性化匹配与计算效率。现有目标感知模型虽能捕捉用户对不同候选的兴趣差异，但通常需为每个候选独立处理历史序列，导致高延迟。论文核心问题是：如何在保持细粒度用户-候选兼容性建模的同时，实现可重用的历史编码路径，以支持大规模候选集的高效排序。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究基于用户近期交互历史对候选集进行打分排序的任务。输入为固定历史序列与动态候选集合，输出为每个候选的排序得分。模型采用端到端训练，使用点击预测常用的BPR损失，并在公开与工业数据集上评估AUPRC、NDCG等指标。推理阶段特别关注候选数量增长下的延迟表现，对比多种基线模型在不同服务模式下的质量-延迟权衡。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出相似性-身份解耦框架及其实例化模型MELODI，其关键贡献在于通过理论保证的池化顺序等价性，实现了历史信息的可重用编码。实验表明，MELODI在多个数据集上达到或超越强基线的排序性能，同时在大候选集下显著降低延迟，尤其结合请求级历史复用后优势更明显，验证了解耦设计在实际系统中的有效性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心是将用户-候选匹配信号拆分为相似性分支与身份分支。相似性分支利用跨注意力聚合历史信息，并通过一个在历史输入上线性的交叉操作确保‘先池化后相似’的等价性，从而允许共享历史编码。身份分支单独建模候选自身属性。该机制使模型能在一次历史编码后批量处理所有候选，大幅减少重复计算。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文局限在于依赖离线日志数据，未进行线上A/B测试，且工业数据不可公开。延迟测量仅基于单一处理器类型。尽管如此，其提出的解耦原则与高效架构设计对工业级推荐系统具有明确指导意义，最值得阅读的是问题抽象方式、理论条件推导与真实场景下的系统优化实践。
